name: Body - Fall, heavy dangerous
description:
Body falling heavily onto a wooden surface, thud inside a house. I shook a heavy curtain on the stairs to do this one. No one was hurt during the process :)
* No background noise.
* No reverb nor echo.
* Clean sound, close range. Recorded with Iphone 8 or Thomann micro t.bone SC 420.

name: Heavy Impacts
description:
Recording of a heavy sack hitting the floor from a decent height. Inspired by the phrase "down like a sack of spuds" and the classic Hollywood method of dropping bags of potatoes to simulate the sound of a body hitting the floor.
Could be used for when someone collapses due to being rendered unconscious or killed, or falling from a great height. Could also be used for punches, kicks and chops. I think it has enough bite to it for a wood chop. 
Sorry about the slight hiss. My microphone has a fault. It shouldn't be too hard to clean up or disguise by lowering the volume of the sound.

name: body-fall-3.wav
description: This is a sound I created for a film known as hard pan zingers (check it out on YouTube http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NK8f1Q8ARl4&feature;=plcp ) we needed a lot of bodies falling to the ground so we ended up creating a couple different sounds for it. One of the sounds was created by me literately throwing myself on a hard concrete surface, the other 3 were created by dropping a punching bag on the same hard cold surface. This sound is part of the filmmakers archive by Dane S Casperson A rich collection of creative commons sound fx for filmmakers by a filmmaker www.thefilmmakersarchive.com Equipment used: AT875r Cardioid mic run into a zoom H4N ~Dane Vandewiele
